# dsh-claude-effort-slider

> A Claude Desktop–style **Effort** slider for DeepSeek Harness.
> It replaces the composer's Effort

switch with a draggable five-level control — **Low / Medium / High / Max / Ultracode** —
> includin
g the Ultracode WebGL2 energy grid. **Ultracode always drives the model's maximum thinking effort.**
**English** · 中文
*Running in DeepSeek Harness: the `Effort: Ultracode` pill beside the model seat, and the popover wi
th the Ultracode grid lit.*
## What it does
| Surface | Behaviour |
| Composer tool row | An `Effort: <level>` pill (gauge icon + label + chevron), violet and glowing a

t Ultracode |
| Click the pill | Opens the Effort popover above the composer card: Faster / Smarter,
five stop dots, white pill thumb, per-level copy, the High-usage warning at Max, the Ultracode swit

ch, the energy grid |
| The shipped **Effort / 推理等级** row in the model menu | Intercepted: it opens
the popover instead of the level list, and the menu dismisses itself — the popover becomes the only

surface on screen |
| ⌥ / ⌘ / Ctrl + click that row | Passes through, so the shipped level list (inc
luding `off`) stays reachable |
The effort value is written through the **same per-session model directory** the shipped menu and th

e
`/model` popup use (`ctx.modelDirectories.directoryFor(session).select(...)`), so a change from ei

ther side
shows up in the other. Only `reasoningEffort` is written — provider and model are untouche

Level names are fixed (Claude's); the ladder comes from the model's own advertised reasoning efforts

| Level | Writes |

| Low | `low` (then `minimal`, `medium`) |
| Medium | `medium` |
| High | `high` |
| Max | `max` (th

en `xhigh`, `high`) |
| **Ultracode** | **the top of the ladder** — the model's maximum thinking eff

Name matching wins; when a catalog uses other names the five levels are spread by rank
(`round(i*(n-

1)/4)`) and forced monotonic. `off` never enters the five levels: Claude's leftmost level is

On a `low / medium / high / max` ladder, Max and Ultracode write the same wire value; Ultracode addi

tionally
means *this session runs in Ultracode mode*, remembered per session in
`localStorage["dsh-c

## Interaction
| Gesture | Result |

| Drag the thumb | Continuous follow; the level label updates live |
| Release | Spring snap to the

nearest level (`stiffness 520 / damping 38`) and **one** write |
| Click the track / a stop dot | Ju

mps there and snaps |
| `← → ↑ ↓` | Step one level |
| `Home` / `End` | First / last level |
| `Ente

r` / `Space` | Snap the current position |
| Ultracode switch | On → far right, off → Max (one write

each) |
| `Esc` / click outside | Closes |
Dragging only moves the picture; the write happens on settle, so a drag never floods the model RPC.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
In the **Desktop app** the profile is managed by the app itself: install the repository (or the chec

kout
directory) through Plugin Manager, or from an agent session with
`plugin_manager install_bundle
target=/path/to/dsh-claude-effort-slider`.
Then restart DeepSeek Harness, or refresh the window (`⌘R` / `Ctrl+F5`). There is no build step — th

e
browser half is a plain client bundle committed as `client.js`.

## Project layout
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The browser half registers two slot entries:

- `conversation.input.right` — the pill (session scoped, `order: 40`)
- `conversation.input.overlay`
— the popover, floating inside the composer card (`order: 60`)
## 1:1 fidelity
Markup, class names (prefixed `ccs-`), numbers and copy are ported from the reference `index.html` /
`styles.css` / `app.js`:
- **Popover** 272px wide, 14px padding, 14px radius, `#20201f` surface, the same inset ring and drop

shadows.
- **Track** 24px tall, 4px radius, `rgba(255,255,255,.1)`; the filled region is 26% white,

turning violet at Ultracode.
- **Thumb** a 20×24 white pill with a 0.12s overshoot scale and a viol

et halo at Ultracode.
- **Stops** five 3px dots that scale to 1.35 on hover.
- **Text effects** the

220ms `opacity / translateY / blur` re-entry of the level label, the violet
`text-shadow` on the lab

el and the switch title at Ultracode, the amber warning line with its `!` badge at
Max, the `?` hove

r tooltip, the muted `Effort` title.
- **Grid** `GRID_VS` / `GRID_FS` copied verbatim: 4px pitch, 3p

x cells with 0.9px corners, eight burst slots
with a Manhattan wavefront, a five-step discrete ramp,

breathing only on the hottest cells,
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
DeepSeek Harness with the `ui-conversation` and `ui-model-selection` client packages (both ship with

the web
app). Developed and installed on DSH Desktop (macOS, Electron web GUI, DSH 0.2.x line).
### 兼容性

需要带 `ui-conversation` 与 `ui-model-selection` 两个客户端包的 DeepSeek Harness（web 应用自带）。
开发与安装环境：DSH Desktop
（macOS，Electron web GUI，DSH 0.2.x 一线）。
